sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Welcome to {{company.name}}. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy informs you about how we collect, use, and process your personal data when you use our website and services, as well as your rights under applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: 2. The Data We Collect
sections.content: We may collect, use, store, and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, which we have grouped together as follows:

dataTypes.name: Identity Data
dataTypes.description: includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier

dataTypes.name: Contact Data
dataTypes.description: includes email address and telephone numbers

dataTypes.name: Technical Data
dataTypes.description: includes internet protocol (IP) address, browser type and version, time zone setting and location, browser plug-in types and versions, operating system and platform, and other technology on the devices you use to access this website

dataTypes.name: Usage Data
dataTypes.description: includes information about how you use our website and services

dataTypes.name: Generated Content Data
dataTypes.description: includes content inputs provided by you (which may contain personal data, depending on your input)

dataTypes.name: Marketing and Communications Data
dataTypes.description: includes your preferences in receiving marketing from us and our third parties and your communication preferences

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
sections.content: We will only process your personal data when permitted by law. Most commonly, we rely on the following legal bases under Article 6 of the GDPR:
uses: Performance of a contract: to provide and maintain our service
Legal obligation: to comply with applicable legal requirements
Legitimate interests: to monitor and improve our services, maintain security, and prevent abuse
Consent: where we ask for your consent, such as for optional communications or cookies

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing and Third Parties
sections.content: We use trusted third-party services to operate and improve our platform. These providers may process personal data on our behalf:

thirdParties.name: OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Suno, Luma Dreamlabs, ImmersityAI, Creatomate
thirdParties.purpose: Content generation services (may receive user input that could contain personal data)

thirdParties.name: Beehiiv
thirdParties.purpose: Email newsletter service for sending updates, managing waitlist, and marketing communications

sections.additionalContent: Some of these providers may be located outside the EU/EEA. In such cases, data transfers are carried out in compliance with Chapter V of the GDPR, based on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or adequacy decisions.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including legal, accounting, or reporting obligations. User accounts and associated data will be deleted if they remain inactive for an extended period, in accordance with GDPR-compliant retention rules.

sections.title: 6. Data Security
sections.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to prevent unauthorized access, misuse, loss, or disclosure of your personal data. Access is limited to those with a business need to know.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
rights: Right of access – obtain a copy of your personal data
Right to rectification – correct inaccurate data
Right to erasure – delete your data ('right to be forgotten')
Right to restriction of processing – limit how we use your data
Right to data portability – receive your data in a usable format
Right to object – object to data processing based on legitimate interests
Right to withdraw consent – if processing is based on your consent

sections.title: 8. Marketing and Newsletter
sections.content: If you have opted to join our waitlist or receive our newsletter, we process your email address and name (if provided) to send you updates about our product launch, service information, and marketing communications. This processing is based on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in our emails or contacting us directly. We use Beehiiv as our newsletter service provider, which helps us manage subscriber lists, send emails, and track engagement metrics (such as email opens and clicks) to improve our communications.
